supersessionScope.supersedesOnly: Ordinary deterministic DATA_UPDATE execution sequence, resume behavior, timeout recovery and repeated conversational apply-authorization semantics where Evergreen V5 applies.
doesNotSupersede: immutable build discipline for code changes

classification.DATA_UPDATE: Data-only deterministic delta using an approved existing write mechanism; no source/build/deploy change.
classification.CODE_DEFECT: A causal product defect requiring source change and release discipline.
classification.RELEASE_DEPLOY: Promotion/deploy activity governed by immutable artifact rules.

applyPrerequisites: approved write mechanism or write contract verified

executionCursorEnforcement.cursorAuthority: The active module source-intake execution object is the canonical resume cursor for ordinary DATA_UPDATE work.
executionCursorEnforcement.resumeBehavior: On every continuation or timeout recovery, read the active module source intake and execute its nextRequiredStep. Do not repeat any prior state that already has material evidence unless a concrete reproducible drift invalidates that evidence.
executionCursorEnforcement.timeoutRecovery: A timeout or interrupted message never resets the module. Resume from the last physically evidenced cursor state and continue forward only.
executionCursorEnforcement.checkpointRule: After each material step, update the active module source-intake execution object with state, evidence pointer, writes count and nextRequiredStep. Do not create a new methodology or parallel checkpoint system.

cycleBudget.secondCycleAllowedOnlyFor: A concrete causal correction or isolated ambiguity resolution.
cycleBudget.afterMaximumCycles: Either close the module or record a precise HOLD. Further broad diagnosis is forbidden.

executionCursorEnforcement.evidenceMinimality: Intermediate analysis is not a gate. Canonize only source identity, material cursor transitions, deterministic diff/apply/readback evidence, precise HOLDs and terminal closure.

importerRule.existingPlatformImporterPreferredOnlyAft: Its target-specific contract and controlled LIVE persistence/readback are proven.

resumeRule: On every continuation, read CONTROL_PLANE, this lock, the operating plan, registry, and active module source intake; then execute only the source-intake nextRequiredStep. Conversation text is context, not authority, and interrupted responses do not reset progress.
